projects.heading: Projects
projects.subtitle: Real problems. Production solutions. Measurable impact.

truekapp.headline: Real-time bartering platform with WebSocket-powered messaging
truekapp.problem: Users needed to negotiate item exchanges instantly without page refreshes or delays.
truekapp.solution: Built a complete Laravel platform with real-time private messaging via WebSockets, offer management workflows, and an admin moderation panel for content control.

managepoint.headline: Internal management platform with automated reporting
managepoint.problem: Gaming venue operations relied on manual processes and scattered data across multiple systems.
managepoint.solution: Developed a full-stack management system with role-based access control, automated PDF report generation, and optimized database queries via Laravel migrations.

valorant.headline: Character browser with external REST API consumption
valorant.problem: Valorant players wanted a fast, visual way to browse characters and their abilities.
valorant.solution: Built a responsive web app consuming the Valorant REST API with dynamic content rendering and light/dark theme switching.
